      A LETTER, JUST FOR YOU

      Dear Asechka,

      Asnat to the world. Asechka to me.

      I wanted to make you something small, but filled with a feeling that isn't small at all.

      I love you. And I love that, in a world this big, I get to know you. Just thinking about you can turn the most ordinary moment into something I want to keep.

      This little website is a piece of that feeling. A few stars, two cats, and a whole lot of things I wish I could say perfectly.

      There's one more little thing I've been keeping close to my heart. I won't give it away here. Just save a moment for me on Friday.

      Until then, let this be your reminder: you mean so much to me.

      With all my love,
      me ♡
